column1: # build/tlib-packages.tsv -- tape-library (tlib) packages. Read by tools/cxlib/tlibpkg.cx (tools/layer-api.cx, tools/tlib.cx).
# opaque (optional eighth field): PATH=REASON, units packed as objects whose interface the product does not print; no module can `use` them, the link takes them by symbol.

# version X.Y.Z: X breaking interface change, Y additive change, Z implementation release point. api_sha is the sha256 of build/layer-api/PKG.tsv at this version (tools/layer-api.cx --write prints it and the bump class).

# roots: directories (their own regular *.cx; a symlinked unit belongs to the package holding the real file) or .cx files. exclude: PATH=REASON, never packed, a link that needs one is refused. deps: PKG@minimum-version.
# The release chain and gen1/g2/g3 build cold from source and never read a tlib.

column7: L0 mem: sized heap, bounded bytes, grow, slice, arena, vec, map (split from cx.base, CXS-C4)
L0 text: text, fmt, num, build, deflate, iter, edit, utf8, codec, conv (split from cx.base, CXS-C4)
L0 sys: syscall-height units with no dependence on os units (split from cx.base, CXS-C4); fd/poll/tty/process still live in ext.sysx
L0 os: env, fs, posix, proc, runlaunch, time (split from cx.base, CXS-C4)
internal: cx/core executor and cx/owned (what is left of the old cx.base after the CXS-C4 split; sys/mem/text moved to cx.sys/cx.os/cx.mem/cx.text)
process, reaper, poll, fd, tty, guard, childdepth, trace; process_group defines the prelude's setpgid
item, pipe: bounded byte pipeline with receipts (reached as stream.item/stream.pipe)
path: pure path functions, posix and win styles (reached as path)
cx0 ring: plan, bundle (the module plan and the bundle the driver compiles from)
runtime ring: model/package decode, frames, caches, route steps, the generated name tables and nets of the run side
compiler ring: module resolver, gates, tape link and object tape, forward signatures, the generated name tables and nets of the compile side
driver ring: args, cli, route, input/output, path, deps, archive, environment
sha256, hkdf, aes, gcm, chacha20poly1305, x25519, p256, bn, rsa, der, x509, b64, ct, record, tls13: pure cx crypto and TLS 1.3 (reached as crypto.NAME)
tool-side library: netpack, resolver, release*, proc/run helpers (reached as cxlib.NAME)
